name: Amendments by the committee responsible – separate and split votes
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulation (EU) 2023/956 as regards the extension of its scope to downstream goods and anti-circumvention measures
section: Article 30 – paragraph 6 – subparagraph 2 – point b – point ii d (new)
part_text: (ii d) technical and policy options for the gradual inclusion of indirect emissions into the CBAM in further sectors, including the impact of such an extension on the competitiveness and decarbonisation of energy-intensive sectors in the Union, the availability of reliable and verifiable data, the current dispersion of national indirect cost compensation measures and its implications for the uniform application of Union carbon pricing;
